name: ffmpeg
scope: MP4 major brand, title, two tracks, 2x2 video dimensions
family_note: C and C++ call sites share libavformat; the MP4 box parser is in the MOV demuxer.

name: gstreamer
scope: MP4 title, video/audio streams and 2x2 video dimensions
family_note: C and C++ call sites share the pinned isomp4/qtdemux plugin.

name: mpv
scope: MP4 demuxer, title and H.264/AAC track codecs
family_note: C and C++ call sites share libmpv, which links the FFmpeg package already listed directly.

name: vlc
scope: MP4 title, video/audio tracks and one-second duration
family_note: C and C++ call sites share libVLC and its bundled MP4 demuxer; exact plugin selection during this run was not independently traced.

name: gpac
scope: two ISO media tracks, 2x2 video dimensions and duration
family_note: C and C++ call sites share the same gpac native MP4 parser. GPAC MP4Box is a CLI alias within the gpac package, not another package row.

name: taglib
scope: MP4 title metadata and one-second duration
family_note: C binding delegates to the same TagLib C++ MP4 parser used by the C++ adapter.

name: opencv
scope: MP4 video dimensions, frame count and frame rate from FFmpeg-backed VideoCapture
family: OpenCV VideoCapture wrapper over FFmpeg MOV/MP4 demuxer
family_note: The pinned libopencv_videoio dylib links the pinned FFmpeg libavformat and libavcodec libraries; this is a distinct C++ package API over the FFmpeg parser family.

name: exiv2
license_evidence: Pinned upstream COPYING in v0.28.9 source and Homebrew license field
input_api: Exiv2::ImageFactory::open(local MP4 filename); Image::readMetadata(); XmpData::findKey for QuickTime/MP4 fields
scope: MP4 major brand and video dimensions from parsed QuickTime XMP metadata
family_note: Exiv2 has a native QuickTimeVideo reader in src/quicktimevideo.cpp; this is not the FFmpeg or TagLib parser family.

name: libheif
input_api: heif_context_read_from_file(local MP4 path); heif_context_number_of_sequence_tracks; heif_context_get_track; heif_track_get_image_resolution
scope: MP4 video sequence track and 2x2 image resolution; the library does not expose the audio track through this sequence API
family: libheif native ISO BMFF image-sequence and MP4 parser
family_note: C and C++ adapters call the same libheif 1.23.7 C API and parser. This separate parser reads the MP4 video sequence and ignores audio.

name: libopenshot
license_evidence: https://github.com/OpenShot/libopenshot/blob/v1.1.1/COPYING and SPDX header in pinned FFmpegReader.h
scope: FFmpegReader opened a valid MP4, reporting H.264 video, AAC audio and 2x2 dimensions
family: OpenShot FFmpegReader over FFmpeg MOV/MP4 demuxer
family_note: Distinct tagged OpenShot C++ package/API, built with tagged OpenShotAudio; FFmpegReader uses libavformat and shares the existing FFmpeg parser family.
